name: Swedish Pancakes
subtitle: Levi’s favorite
notes: Grandpa Kemper used to get up in the morning and make these for the family. This recipe has been healthified, just a bit.

steps.title: Blend the batter
steps.body: Combine in blender: **3 cups milk**, **1½ cups flour**, **3 Tbsp melted shortening**, **2 Tbsp sugar**, **1 tsp salt**, **3 eggs**, **1½ tsp cinnamon** and less nutmeg.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve with apple butter, sour cream, jam, etc.
